title: Enviri Boosts Steel Scrap Recycling 99% in 2025
dek: According to a Wisevoter headline, Enviri boosted its steel scrap recycling by 99% in 2025.
summary: According to a Wisevoter headline, Enviri boosted its steel scrap recycling by 99% in 2025. The publisher provided no excerpt. The headline does not specify the base figure, the volumes involved or the regions covered.
keyFacts: Headline states Enviri boosted steel scrap recycling 99% in 2025
whyItMatters: Scrap is the main feedstock for electric arc furnace steelmaking, so growth in recycling capacity could matter for scrap availability. Without volumes, the scale cannot be judged.
implications: EAF producers and scrap traders may wish to watch for fuller disclosures on volumes and markets served before drawing conclusions about supply.
